topic: Is a second job worth it? On extra income, federal tax plus income-tested benefit reductions (CCB 13.5% for two children between $38,237 and $82,847 of AFNI; CGEB 5% above $46,432) can take about a third before provincial tax, CPP and EI; benefit reductions apply from the next July

example.note: example (not a CRA rule): Kai's family, two children, adjusted family net income $50,000 → $60,000 with a $10,000 weekend job in 2026. Federal tax 2026: ($58,523 − $50,000) × 14% = $1,193.22 + ($60,000 − $58,523) × 20.5% = $302.79 → $1,496.01. CCB (2 children, AFNI between $38,237 and $82,847): 13.5% × $10,000 = $1,350/yr less. CGEB (couple + 2 children, max $1,358): 5% × $10,000 = $500/yr less (both incomes above $46,432 after the change: $50,000 and $60,000). Total $3,346.01 (33.5%); kept $6,653.99. Benefit thresholds shown are July 2026–June 2027 values; the 2026 income affects July 2027–June 2028 benefits, whose thresholds will be re-indexed. Provincial tax, CPP and EI not included.
